auth_details: No API key required for public WONDER datasets; requests are unauthenticated SOAP/XML POSTs to dataset-specific endpoints.
free_tier_limits: Free public access; no paid plans. Usage subject to fair-use / automated query limits (not a published free-tier quota).
rate_limits: not published as fixed req/day; CDC restricts automated bulk querying and may block excessive use
description: CDC WONDER (Wide-ranging Online Data for Epidemiologic Research) provides access to CDC public health datasets—including mortality, natality, cancer, and environmental data—via a web-based query system and SOAP/XML API. Developers can submit structured requests to retrieve aggregated statistical tables for research, surveillance, and health analytics.
resolution_notes: Auditing disputes about SOAP vs form-POST XML and example validity.
